subject: Air freight quote: MUC to GRU
body:
Hi,

Could you quote an all-in price in EUR for the fastest air freight option from MUC to GRU (Sao Paulo, BR)? The shipment will be ready on 2026-11-27, and we’ll deliver it to MUC ourselves.

It’s 5 pieces of automotive sensors, 1384 kg gross and 11.69 cbm total. Each piece is 140 x 100 x 167 cm. The packing list is attached.

Mira Petersen
Nordlicht Audio
